items.title: Seven Days Alone on the Ridge Line — A Silent Hiking Film
items.subtitle: Description
items.overview: Seven days along the ridge line with one pack and no plan for the weather. Filmed in silence: no narration and no music, only what the microphones heard. Route notes, elevation and the full gear list are below, with a chapter for every day of the walk. Day one starts at the trailhead at dusk and ends at the first camp, a flat shelf under the saddle. Day four is the storm: nothing was planned, the tent held, the microphones kept running. The descent on day seven follows the old hut path; the hut itself has been closed for years. Gear: one 55 litre pack, a two-wall tent, a gas stove, three lenses and far too many batteries. No drone was flown anywhere along the ridge. Thank you for walking with us.
